preconditions: owner has a current deck/item revision and stable selected node IDs
flows.event: publish one SELF_CHECK, FREE_RESPONSE, CLOZE, CHOICE or MATCH exercise with typed content slots, an answer key and an objective title
flows.persistedEffect: one stable objective, immutable objective/exercise revisions, server-derived bindings, media references for every media block and a new deck exercise root commit atomically
flows.errorOrRecovery: foreign resources are opaque 404; stale pins are VERSION_CONFLICT; a disabled or provider-less capability is CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE; reload and republish

preconditions: READY candidate generation exists for the current exercise root
flows.persistedEffect: session pins deck revision, generation, reducer, account timezone, seed and budget; issued objectives gain current-epoch exposure
flows.errorOrRecovery: missing generation returns 202 PREPARING; poll status without a full scan

preconditions: active scheduled presentation and current learning epoch
flows.event: submit a free-response, cloze, self-check, choice or match response
flows.persistedEffect: terminal receipt, normalized evidence, one reducer transition and 30-day raw child row commit atomically
flows.errorOrRecovery: exact retry returns stored outcome; conflict or expiry never adds a transition

flows.persistedEffect: terminal receipt records NOT_ASSESSED without evidence or StudyState transition

preconditions: presentation expiresAt is before the server clock
flows.persistedEffect: no receipt, evidence or state transition is written
flows.errorOrRecovery: request a current presentation; timeout is never incorrect evidence

preconditions: a completed source session exists for the same account, deck and account-local date
flows.event: replay the pinned presentation sequence without prior responses
flows.persistedEffect: bounded replay session only; no exposure, evidence or StudyState
flows.errorOrRecovery: missing eligible source session returns a stable validation error and suggests scheduled/practice

preconditions: owner is authenticated; introduced objectives exist unless includeNew is true
flows.event: start bounded weak-first or seeded practice
flows.persistedEffect: bounded practice session only; no canonical exposure or state
flows.errorOrRecovery: empty eligible pool returns EMPTY and allows leaving or explicit includeNew

preconditions: server-issued session mode is PRACTICE or REPLAY
flows.event: submit an assessed response for feedback
flows.persistedEffect: short-lived compact receipt only; no raw, evidence, transition, exposure or experiment result
flows.errorOrRecovery: retry is idempotent during receipt window; expired ID remains tombstoned

preconditions: owner is authorized for the deck
flows.errorOrRecovery: foreign deck is opaque 404; empty deck returns an empty page

preconditions: owner selects one or more current deck members
flows.persistedEffect: objective locks in UUID order, epoch increment and zeroed current state; history retained
flows.errorOrRecovery: exact retry returns stored response; old presentations become NOT_ASSESSED

preconditions: pending unexpired CLOZE presentation owned by the caller
flows.event: reveal the first letter of one blank
flows.persistedEffect: one append-only study_hint_reveal row (idempotent); evidence later records FIRST_LETTER:<blankId> and may be capped at MEDIUM
flows.errorOrRecovery: a blank without firstLetterHint or a non-CLOZE presentation is INVALID_REQUEST; foreign or stale presentations are opaque 404

preconditions: AI assessment or speech-to-text flag is false, or true without a provider
flows.event: publish a FREE_RESPONSE exercise with the ai-semantic evaluator or TEXT_OR_SPEECH input
flows.persistedEffect: none; no exercise, objective or media reference is written
flows.errorOrRecovery: read GET /api/capabilities, publish the deterministic variant instead
